top_categories.workout_context: 8,465ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Inthanon Challenge's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before February.
At Inthanon Challenge, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
8,465ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
284ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.

Road-specific control matters at Inthanon Challenge. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 29 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Inthanon Challenge. Train it until it feels boring.
Low-cadence force work supports 8,465ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
29 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Base fitness for Inthanon Challenge. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Inthanon Challenge. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan that matches the ride duration, intensity, and weather. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Inthanon Challenge includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing. Forecast valley-to-summit contrast — Chiang Mai 18-34°C vs. 5-14°C on northern mountaintops per race-day forecasts; Damp, narrow, quiet road surface near the summit.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and Over Under to prepare you for 29 miles of mixed terrain in Chom Thong, Chiang Mai, Thailand.
